title: Spellblade
wikitext:
= Spellblade = The Spellblade Invocation is available to Beastlord, Paladin, Ranger, and Shadow Knight. When active, this Invocation uses the spell gem in the #1 (top) slot as a weapon proc, if that spell has a reuse time (cooldown) less than its cast time. Since this functions as a weapon proc, it uses the smart targeting system for any applicable beneficial spell, meaning that if you combine Spellblade with a healing or buffing spell, when it procs it will automatically target your enemy's target (usually yourself or the tank). Spellblade proc rate is also affected by the mana cost of the spell and your maximum mana pool - lower spell cost and higher mana pool will equate to more procs.
